steps.caption: Zentrix's requirement changed: maximum area went from 28,000 to 30,000 sq ft. Open Review.
In the row of queues, open Stale records, then the Outdated proposals tab.
Top: approved or shared proposals that used the old figures. They are never changed automatically — you decide.
Below: drafts and analyses that need a refresh.
'Recalculated (v…)': the comparison already re-ran as a new version; the old versions are kept.
'May be outdated': figures you entered yourself — open it, check and re-run.
'what changed' shows the old and new values.
Press Refresh on a comparison to bring it up to date. It runs the refresh workflow.
Done — it disappears from the list. Dismiss closes a warning you don't need (it stays in the history).
The same warning appears on the record itself. Open the Zentrix requirement.
New rent quotations work the same way: comparisons recalculate, proposals using the old quote are flagged.
Each reassessment is a job in Automation → Recently finished, with its steps and the records it flagged.
